name: Turkish Context
purpose: Teaches Turkish vocabulary and language usage through real cultural context rather than isolated word lists -- phrases, idioms, and expressions shown the way Turkish speakers actually use them, paired with the cultural background (custom, object, or setting) that gives each one its meaning.
audience: Learners of Turkish as a foreign or heritage language who want usage-in-context over rote memorization, and anyone interested in Turkish language and culture together rather than as separate subjects.
